about: The sites that call has_role() naming Administrator or Shopfloor_Manager and do not call require_mfa(), each with its reason. Every other such site changes the platform and calls it (0251). Mirror check 59 holds the migrations and storage-policies.sql to this file, and test_with_mfa_required_a_write_needs_a_session_that_gave_its_code.py holds the database to it. supabase/README.md, 0251's section, lists every site.

functions.acknowledge_alert: An Operator's write as much as a manager's: acknowledging an alert changes no platform state.
functions.withdraw_alert_acknowledgement: The other half of acknowledging an alert, which an Operator may do too.
functions.app_approvals: A read: who allows an app.
functions.audit_trail_backup_job_ids_matching: A read: the Audit Trail's search.
functions.audit_trail_user_ids_matching: A read: the Audit Trail's search.
functions.backup_summary: A read: the Backups page's figures.
functions.cold_archive_backlog: A read: the Cold Storage page.
functions.cold_storage_rows: A read: the Cold Storage page.
functions.display_names_for: A read: the names the dashboard shows.
functions.end_my_other_sessions: A person's own sessions, in any role.
functions.end_my_session: A person's own session, in any role.
functions.foreign_credential_is_set: A read: whether a credential is set, never what it is.
functions.notification_webhook_status: A read: whether the webhook has an address and a signing key, never what they are.
functions.gateway_is_playback_delivery_target: A read the playback dialog makes.
functions.is_active_capture_object: A storage predicate; the write policies call require_mfa() in the arm beside it.
functions.is_active_playback_capture: A storage predicate the read policy calls.
functions.is_own_avatar_object: A person's own picture, in any role.
functions.is_unclaimed_capture_object: A storage predicate; the write policies call require_mfa() in the arm beside it.
functions.issue_capture_download: A read: downloading a stored capture, which an Auditor may do too.
functions.list_my_app_approvals: A read: a person's own approvals.
functions.list_my_sessions: A read: a person's own sessions.
functions.may_decide_proposal: A predicate: approve_proposal() and reject_proposal() call require_mfa() themselves, and list_proposer_names() reads by it.
functions.playback_delivery_targets: A read the playback dialog makes.
functions.playback_stale_credentials: A read the playback dialog makes.
functions.raw_telemetry_window: A read: the Cold Storage page.
functions.record_service_logs_read: Records a read of a service's logs: reading is never refused.
functions.set_own_picture: A person's own picture, in any role.
functions.show_gateway_credential: Shows a stored gateway credential again: a read, which the switch never refuses.
